spiritgiven.comments:
Good part to notes:
1. When calls happened, you always listen to our perspective first，and with the help of sideline，you kindly retract some calls. good spirits to go！
2. About fast count，we think we have slow down  at the last few second specially, but still been called, but we will keep notice this!

As we communicated during the spirit circle and final circle, we both agree that we have different standards about the rules use and body contact. There were multiple body contacts made by your team that could have been avoided (Eg. pushing and pulling while defending us). After the spirit timeout, we felt that things did not improved as we expected. Components like temper and attitude control need to be improved.
About calls, we felt that we have the right to share our perspective, as we did, b

When the calls were made，some players cant tell the clear vision of the actions，and want to end up with contest.  more calls were made at the next half, some 50% vs 50% calls were made to stop our flows.

Fair mindedness: when calls were made on the field, your player always listening to our perspectives and retracted some calls after.
We had many communications both on or off the field, which made the game better.

spiritreceived.comments: We felt there were too many fast counts. Aside from that, thank you for a respectful and fair game. It’s wonderful to have you here in Australia.

The 0 in Fair mindedness is due to: they only took the stance that they were right. In more occasions it seems calls were guided from outside: players look to sideline instead of having discussion, some decisions to accept or contest calls arrive from side.
When the side (player/coach) have views on a play (in/out calls) after signed with hand signals didn't help teammates on field.

Thank you for the game!

Both of our teams showed that they really wanted the disc and we feel like it was physical on both sides. After adjusting, we feel it was less physical as the game continued.

For fair mindedness, we did not think it was fair when you mentioned that your team will make more calls if our team keeps making calls.

Thank you for adjusting after we mentioned the rule about where sideline teammates can bring the disc closer to the field.

Best of luck!

- We've feedback to the spirit captain regarding the body contacts however we think there might be a miscommunication as the message wasn't delivered to the players and there was maybe very less attempt to avoid contacts between players.
- We've also highlighted regarding the fast counts that was called after the stall-out call which we think it needs to be called earlier.
- Glad that both team have clarified regarding the pick calls between handlers movement
The coach corrected his players in the regulations but after when it was necessary. For this reason they stopped the game a lot with calls that were not correct.

We put a 2 for contact, but it was on the lower side of two with a lot of contact on the mark. 
For fair-mindedness we put 2, but it was on the higher end of 2 since they acknowledged when calls were made but wouldn’t affected the outcome. 
Likewise with attitude around the feel was good and on the higher end of 2.
Very aware of female players and avoided contact, quick resolutions on calls
